name: com.coffeebean.purchase
description: Independent in-app purchase module based on Unity IAP 5.4. Excel-driven product config, optional server-side receipt verification, restore purchases. Works standalone or integrated with CoffeeBean Core.

samples.description: 完整购买流程示例：初始化、商品下发缓存、购买（可选服务器核销）、发货、恢复购买。编辑器可用假商店跑通全流程。
